name: tau-banking-memory-cohort-01-first-outage-recovery
selection: Only the named 160 terminal HTTP 502/503 customer requests in the registered 04:16–04:19 UTC incident. Verify the original sealed allocations, request, response, actor, missing grade, source and writer snapshot. One fresh consultation per eligible original allocation.
accounting: Carry the full sealed, reported plus reserved, cost of the initial release. Total combined ceiling USD 7. The recovery is a new allocation and requires its own affirmative authorization.
execution: Attach the provider receipt watcher before the consultations. Hold after two transient customer errors in 30 seconds. Probe with an existing assignment after 120, 600 or 1800 seconds or a longer Retry-After. Do not resubmit an attempted recovery consultation.
analysis: Publish the initial registered results unchanged, followed by a sensitivity table filling only the 160 registered missing slots. Retain residual missingness and costs, report grades by wave and distinguish pairs with one versus two newly observed arms. Cross-wave contrasts can also reflect provider time. No entire-cohort performance inference or expansion without customer-disjoint confirmation.
